label: GT-805A 10/100/1000T to SFP media converter
description: Standalone media converter with one 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 port and one SFP (mini-GBIC) slot that accepts 100BASE-FX or 1000BASE-SX/LX optics. Reach and wavelength come entirely from the pluggable, so a 100M pair of SFPs gives a 100M link and 1G SFPs give 1G.
